strengths: Correctly identifies the B-lymphoid lineage using PAX5, EBF1, CD79B, BACH2, SPIB, TCF4, CD72 and SYK.
Recognizes the coexistence of a pre-B/early B-cell program and a plasmablast/plasma-cell program rather than forcing a single subtype.
weaknesses: Stays deliberately broad at B cell/lymphoid lineage and does not exploit the supported hierarchical refinement to precursor B cell.
Interprets the evidence partly as possible doublets without resolving the dominant precursor B-cell identity.

strengths: Top1 B cell branch is supported by extensive B-lineage markers (PAX5, EBF1, CD79B, BACH2, SPIB, TCF4).
Top2 candidate precursor B cell is directly supported by MME, VPREB1, VPREB3, IGLL1, IGLL5, TCL1A and CD9.
Provides the ontology-valid descendant refinement to CL:0000817.
weaknesses: The top1 label does not explicitly flag the plasma/plasmablast secondary program in the final identity.

strengths: Correctly detects genuine plasma/plasmablast markers in the cluster: MZB1, IGLC1, IRF4 and CD38.
weaknesses: Plasma cell as the primary identity is contradicted by PAX5, EBF1, BACH2, SPIB, VPREB1, IGLL1, TCL1A and MME, which are not expected in committed plasma cells.
Selectively uses plasma markers while ignoring the stronger precursor B-cell program in the same marker list.

supporting: B-lineage identity supported by PAX5, EBF1, CD79B, BACH2, SPIB, TCF4, CD72, SYK, HLA-DRA.
Precursor B-cell refinement supported by MME, VPREB1, VPREB3, IGLL1, IGLL5, TCL1A, CD9.
Secondary plasma/plasmablast program observed via IRF4, IGLC1, MZB1, CD38.
Enrichment for immunoglobulin complex and KEGG hsa04640 is consistent with B-lineage biology.
conflicting: Committed plasma cell identity conflicts with PAX5, EBF1, BACH2, SPIB, VPREB1, IGLL1, TCL1A and MME expression.
Pure precursor B-cell identity conflicts with MZB1, IGLC1, IRF4 and CD38 plasma markers in the same cluster.
enrichment_or_literature: Enrichment terms 'immunoglobulin complex' and KEGG hsa04640 support B-lineage identity.
Retrieved literature (PMID 37407551) is consistent with B-lineage interpretation.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
